items.rationale: The second argument is 2, so LEFT returns the first two characters, BT. BT- would need 3 characters and B would need 1.
When num_chars is left out, LEFT uses 1, so only the first character, S, is returned. It is not an error.
LEFT("2499",2) returns the text 24. In arithmetic Excel converts numeric-looking text to a number, so 24 + 1 = 25.
Asking LEFT for 20 characters from a 9-character text returns the whole text, SD-120-38, and LEN of that is 9. LEFT never pads the result.
